questions.stem: A 32-year-old primigravida woman at 39 weeks gestation is admitted to the labor and delivery unit in active labor. She has been progressing well, but there is delayed progress in the 2nd stage of labor. The obstetrician decides to use vacuum extraction to assist with the delivery. The appropriate application of ventouse in this scenario involves:

options.label: A
options.text: Placing the cup on the fetal occiput and applying traction during maternal contractions

options.label: B
options.text: Placing the cup on the fetal occiput and applying continuous traction until delivery

options.label: C
options.text: Placing the cup on the fetal forehead and applying continuous traction until delivery

options.label: D
options.text: Placing the cup on the fetal forehead and applying traction during maternal contractions
